id.description: Stable slug used for wiki links and cross-linking.

category.description: World, Regions, Nations, Factions, Ships, Economy, Creatures, GM Tools, Rules, or other future category.

summary.description: Reader-facing summary. This must not replace the full source-derived body.

body.description: Reader-facing lore paragraphs. Internal wiki hotlinks use [[entry-id|visible text]]. Do not reduce source material to only a digest; preserve the full lore substance in body/sections or source chunks.

sections.description: Optional titled sections for deeper wiki entries. Sections should preserve source lore first; builder/editor sections should be separated from reader-facing lore.

sectionType.description: Optional classification. Default visible sections should be lore-facing.

sourceStatus.description: Shows whether this entry is only a stub, partially imported, source-faithful, fully imported, or generated from a tool.

sourceRefs.description: Hard references to source document pages, outline sections, or extracted source chunks. Generators should use entries with sourceRefs where possible.

sourceChunkIds.description: Optional IDs of raw or near-raw source chunks that this wiki entry incorporates.
